g.text: I'm a Level 5 Computer Science student at IIT and the
University of Westminster, based in Colombo, Sri Lanka.
I like building apps end to end: the mobile screens people tap,
the APIs behind them, and the tests that keep both honest.
Mobile and API work on Sarvodaya Connect, a platform for village societies
Unit and end-to-end tests so endpoints behave before the UI relies on them
Jira and GitHub sprints: branch per task, PR review, squash merge
Currently deep in Spring Boot, database design, and Flutter
